scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm start --prefix backend" "python backend/main.py"
scripts.dev:online: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm start --prefix backend" "python backend/main.py" "npx ngrok http 5188 --log stdout"
